name: updown.io
summary: updown.io charges by the check from prepaid credit packs that start at €5, priced in euros, so a monitor costs more the more often it runs. It checks from 10 locations, confirms downtime from a second location, and gives new accounts 100,000 free credits.

evidence.capability: http and ping checks from many locations

facts.text: A failed check is verified two more times, from at least one other location, before an alert goes out.
An SMS alert uses 7,500 credits, about €0.10.
Team accounts were listed as in progress on updown.io's public feature board.
On May 7, 2026, updown.io reported that problems at its SMS provider may have caused missed SMS alerts.
Data is hosted with OVH in France, Hetzner in Germany and DigitalOcean in the US.

plans.name: Example: 10 sites every 2 minutes
plans.notes: The vendor's own example with the smallest credit pack; €1.83 a month with the largest

hiddenCosts: Prices are in euros and exclude VAT. updown.io publishes no USD price.
SMS alerts are paid from the same credits, at about €0.10 each.

contract.cancellation: Credits are prepaid and the account is never charged automatically unless the customer allows it. Refunds or free credits can be requested by email.
contract.dataExport: Downtimes and metrics through the REST API.
